Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest

Class ProtectionScenarios

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest.ProtectionScenarios
final class ProtectionScenarios extends Object
Protection scenarios. A test listener on the loader's protection events stands in for a claim mod: in game, the same denials come from claiming the target area with a claim mod (for example FTB Chunks or Open Parties and Claims) and acting there as a non-member, or, for dispensers, with the claim mod's fake-player access turned off.

    • handled_block_interaction_denies_dispenser_cauldron_fill

      static void handled_block_interaction_denies_dispenser_cauldron_fill(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A dispenser treats another mod taking the click at its target as refusal, since vanilla dispatch would not pass that click on to the item. In game: with a mod that acts on right-clicks at a cauldron, a dispenser holding a Source Bucket aimed at it does nothing extra.

    • player_fluid_pickup_posts_break_for_each_hand

      static void player_fluid_pickup_posts_break_for_each_hand(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A player's world-fluid pickup posts the block-break event as that player, from either hand. In game: in someone else's claim, look down at water and right-click with an empty Big Bucket in the main hand, then in the off hand; the water stays and both buckets stay empty.

    • refused_place_checks_fallthrough_destination

      static void refused_place_checks_fallthrough_destination(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Forge only, as for refused_place_denies_aquatic_release_water(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper). A placement that falls through to the neighbor of the clicked block posts the place event for that neighbor. In game: standing outside a claim, right-click the side of a block with a Big Bucket of water where the space beside that side is claimed; no water appears and the bucket keeps both units.

    • refused_place_denies_aquatic_release_water

      static void refused_place_denies_aquatic_release_water(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Forge only: on Fabric, placement posts only Architectury's and Common Protection API's checks, which the test environment lacks. In game: a dispenser holding a Mob Bucket with a cod, facing dry air inside a claim that denies fake players, places no water and keeps the cod.

    • refused_pickup_denies_dispenser_absorption

      static void refused_pickup_denies_dispenser_absorption(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Forge only: Fabric API has no item-pickup event. In game: a dispenser with an empty Junk Bucket facing two dropped diamonds, inside a claim that denies fake-player pickup, leaves them on the ground.

    • refused_pickup_denies_player_junk_absorption

      Forge only: Fabric API has no item-pickup event. In game: in a claim that denies item pickup, right-click with a Junk Bucket next to two dropped diamonds; they stay on the ground.
